activation.notes: --activate not set (Tier 2 activation is opt-in — these dev envs are too heavy to reliably activate)

issues: Minor: `gem install bundler -v 4.0.13` pins a likely-nonexistent bundler version (should let Gemfile.lock's BUNDLED WITH drive it or use --conservative alone)
Minor: hook starts/stops its own postgres to createdb while also defining [services.postgres] — slight redundancy but functionally fine for one-time DB init
Nit: pins postgresql_14/redis without version-pinning redis (redis:7 in compose) but acceptable

## Install Packages --------------------------------------------------
[install]
# Language runtimes (pinned — same on every machine)
ruby.pkg-path = "ruby_4_0"          # .ruby-version 4.0.6 · Gemfile.lock · Dockerfile RUBY_VERSION

redis.pkg-path = "redis"                  # docker-compose.yml + devcontainer redis:7 · redis / hiredis-client gems

vips.pkg-path = "vips"              # ruby-vips gem · devcontainer libvips42 · media processing

libidn.pkg-path = "libidn"          # idn-ruby gem · Aptfile libidn12 · Dockerfile libidn12

DB_HOST = "127.0.0.1"

[hook]

      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
